record.goal: Develop and maintain a human resources management web application using Quasar Framework, Vue 3, TypeScript, and Node.js. Follow strict TypeScript practices, never use any, enforce ESLint rules, use Axios for API communication, and implement reusable components, composables, typed props and emits, maintainable architecture, and consistent coding standards. Preserve existing project conventions and avoid unnecessary changes to working code.
